Rae: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: region capacity. Two things folks asked me to clarify: 1) how does the EMEA prewarm path differ from our usual regional autoscaler, and 2) what's the expected customer impact if GPU procurement slips?

Jon: TL;DR: EMEA prewarm is a separate warm pool upstream of the autoscaler. Autoscaler reacts to sustainable pressure; prewarm is a predictive buffer for short spikes. Prewarm == fast warm-ups (~minutes) for interactive SLOs. Autoscaler scales nodes and takes longer (5-30m depending on provider).

Leah: I captured a few bullet points in the notes: prewarm pools hold cached KV and small allocation w/ short TTL; burst/commit buckets are reserved capacity tied to contracts. Prewarm is tenancy-agnostic, burst is customer-tagged.

Kai: For procurement risk: default mitigation is two-fold: route to quantized variants + enable smaller batching, and if necessary shift traffic to adjacent regions with capacity headroom. Expect minor transient increases in CPU utilization and slight cost delta for cross-region routing.

Rae: Can PMs/CS get a one-pager on customer-visible degradation types and expected timelines to share?

Vik: I'll draft one-pager. Short preview: "If prewarm unavailable -> interactive latency may increase on tail p99 by up to 200-400ms for affected customers; sustained high load -> fall back to burst buckets or routed region which may add 50-200ms depending on network." Will attach numbers to each scenario.

Leah: Two operational notes: 1) we added a Capacity view tile in the console under infra -> regions that shows prewarm utilization and burst assignments. 2) We added tags to customer records: reserved_bucket:true or prewarm_eligible:true.

Jon: Ops playbook snippet for quick context (will expand to full runbook):
```
# ops quick flow
if prewarm.degraded:
  notify(#infra-oncall, level=high)
  enable_quantized_routing()
  reduce_batch_size(customers=prewarm_eligible)
  consider_region_failover(window=15m)
```

OpsBot: Playbook page created: https://confluence.redwood/ops/prewarm-fallbacks (staged) :white_check_mark:

Rae: Super helpful, thank you. Action items: Vik to publish one-pager by EOD Fri, Jon to add Prewarm tile to all-hands notes and pin in this thread, Leah to export tag list for CS. I'll coordinate comms with Support after those artifacts are in place. :thumbsup:
